description: Recover embedded Kinect Adventures photos into a ZIP. Inputs stay unchanged.
inputs_help: exported Xbox photo files (any extension), or directories with --recursive
output_help: new destination ZIP; existing files are never overwritten
recursive_help: include files in input directories and their subdirectories
input_missing: Input is not a regular file or directory: {path}
output_exists: Output already exists; choose a new ZIP path: {path}
output_in_inputs: The destination cannot be one of the input files.
file_too_large: File exceeds the 128 MiB limit; select individual exported photo files.
scan_budget: File is too complex or damaged to scan within the safety limit.
read_error: Cannot read this file. Check permissions and try again.
no_photos: No complete JPEG found. Select exported photo files such as PM9_*, not GameProgress or SouvenirRecording.
summary: Recovered {photos} photos from {files} files; skipped {skipped}; failed {failed}. ZIP: {path}
gui_description: Choose your Xbox backup folder and a folder for the recovered JPGs. All subfolders are searched automatically. Originals stay unchanged.
input_help: The main folder containing your exported Xbox 360 files. No need to locate individual photo folders.
output_help_gui: Where to save the recovered JPGs. Existing photos are preserved; identical photos are skipped on reruns.
discovering: Searching the input folder and all subfolders for Kinect Adventures photos...
input_folder_missing: The input folder does not exist. Choose the folder containing your Xbox backup.
same_folders: Choose different input and output folders so your backup stays separate from recovered photos.
candidate_limit: More than 20,000 potential photo files found. Choose a smaller input folder.
source_changed: An input file changed during recovery. Run recovery again after the backup copy finishes.
folder_io_error: Cannot access the selected folders or save the recovery report. Check permissions and free space, then try again. Completed JPGs are preserved.
file_io_error: Could not read this source or save its photos. Check permissions and free space, then rerun.
folder_summary: Recovered: {recovered} JPGs. Already recovered: {existing}. Skipped: {skipped}. Failed: {failed}.
discovery_issues: Could not inspect {count} files or folders. Relative locations are listed in the recovery report.
no_discovered_photos: No new or existing photos were found. Select an exported Xbox backup containing Kinect Adventures PM9_ photo files. GameProgress, SouvenirRecording animations, and raw USB/disk images are not photo inputs.
